page.name: MarketPerformance
page.summary: Displays broad multi-asset market performance data across equities, fixed income, and commodities using PerformanceHeatMap visualizations. The page loads all returns via useMarketData (React Query wrapping loadMarketData from @/lib/dataLoader) and distributes data to tab and panel components via props. Supports an index drilldown mode and an IndexPerformanceModal for detailed per-index history.

page.name: CausalityEngine
page.summary: AI-powered thematic analysis tool. The Discovery tab renders an interactive ThemeBubbleGalaxy that fetches trending themes from /causality/themes via useFilteredThemes; users select 2-3 themes to generate structured analysis. History and Generate tabs are stubbed pending backend DynamoDB and AI integration. All API calls route through causality-endpoints.ts with base URL from VITE_CAUSALITY_API_URL or the default /causality path. State managed via Zustand (causality-store-v2 in localStorage).

page.name: CapitalMarketAssumptions
page.summary: Displays 10-year capital market forecasts and Opal's strategic/tactical allocation views. The 10-Year Assumptions header panel renders a collapsible table across five asset class categories. The Expectations tab renders a Recharts ComposedChart with colored bars (expected returns) and black diamond markers (volatility). The Views tab displays GradientSlider and ConvergingSlider components with split/combined display toggle across Overall, Equity, and Fixed Income views. Data fetched in parallel via React Query from two CloudFront-backed static JSON endpoints.
